snippet.title: Hololive Fan Game - Super Holo Wars - Available Now!
snippet.description:
Get the game here: https://tshadowknight.itch.io/super-holo-wars
And here we finally are then, v1.0. Please spread the news, I'll be needing all the word of mouth I can get, thank you.

We are currently exploring options to make this title available in different languages, with Japanese being high priority. If you are interested in helping out please let us know!

Now, time to get back to writing Chapter 2!
